==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Johnson and I were summoned to the king's court. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (Village King resembles a giant, wooden, elf man who wears a green robe with a white fur collar.)
He questioned why I didn't tell him about Were-Fish Society prior to the Were-Shark invasion. (Were-Fish Society resembles an underwater city made up of glowing, orange, glass, dome shaped pods. There are orange roadways that weave throughout the city, that allow for cars to navigate between the underwater domes. The city is located underwater deep in a river beneath a bridge in the Elven Village.) (Were-Sharks resemble humanoid sharks.)
We were able to convince him that everything worked out in the end, but there can be no more secrets.
